headline: Restored Nutbuster home-screen artwork and protected icon identities

changes.title: Restore the illustrated home-menu buttons
changes.detail: Replaced emoji stand-ins with the existing custom artwork for Nutvale Homestead, Nut Index, Invite Friends and Voice, Music and Effects controls. Play, Levels, companions, mines, wharf, shop and settings now use the same fixed icon registry without changing button placement.

changes.title: Bring back reward-card artwork and prevent silent icon swaps
changes.detail: Lives, VIP and Daily Loot cards once again show their approved image icons instead of heart, crown and gift emoji. Original asset files remain untouched, icon sizes stay within the existing cards, and a visual diagnostic checks the exact menu-to-image assignments.
